runs.text: Hum sab ek aise relation mein paida hote hain jise hum choose nahi karte, par usi ke andar hum
apni poori life define karne lagte hain.
Parent aur child ka relation duniya ka sabse natural bhi hai aur sabse complex bhi — kyunki
yahan sirf love nahi hota, yahan fear, responsibility, expectation, ego aur silence sab ek saath
rehte hain.
Aur sabse badi problem ye nahi hoti ki hum ek dusre se pyaar nahi karte…
problem ye hoti hai ki hum ek dusre ko samajhne ki koshish hi nahi karte.
Hum roles ko dekhte hain  “parent” aur “child”
Insaan ko nahi dekhte.
Aur jab insaan invisible ho jata hai, tab emotions confuse ho jaate hain.
Bachcha apne perspective se dekhta hai aur sochta hai — “mujhe samjha nahi ja raha.”
Parent apne pressure se dekhta hai aur sochta hai — “mujhe follow nahi kiya ja raha.”
Dono apni jagah sahi hote hain, par dono ek hi reality mein nahi hote.
Kyuki reality common nahi hoti… reality interpreted hoti hai.
Har parent apne past ka result hota hai, aur har child apne present ka pressure.
Aur jab past aur present ek hi ghar mein collide karte hain, tab misunderstanding normal ban jati
hai.
Ghar mein aksar shanti hoti hai, par connection nahi hota.
Baat hoti hai, par understanding nahi.
Presence hoti hai, par awareness nahi.
Aur hum is gap ko normal samajh lete hain — jabki yahi gap sab kuch todta hai.
Ye book kisi ko defend karne ke liye nahi hai, aur kisi ko blame karne ke liye bhi nahi.
Ye ek attempt hai us invisible truth ko observe karne ka jo hum daily ignore kar dete hain —
ki shayad hum ek hi ghar mein rehkar bhi ek dusre ke emotional world tak kabhi pohanch hi nahi
paate.
Aur shayad sabse bada shift tab aata hai jab hum samajhna start karte hain ki —
“samajh na aana” bhi ek human reality hai, na ki kisi ki galti.
